Questions

What is Glyph?

An iOS app for reading web novels. It has no content of its own and reads sites through community-built sources.

Is it free?

Yes. No ads, no subscription, no in-app purchases.

What if Apple pulls it, or you stop working on it?

The SDK and source format are open, so sources keep working and anyone can maintain them.

When does it ship?

TestFlight in 2026 to 2027. Leave your email and you get one message the day it opens.
